rules: No new panel directly mutates the legacy runtime model
New UI invokes stable command IDs through ShipyardProfessionalController
New Seed + Generate composes PcgReroll then the same deterministic GenerateVariant path
Test remains a real primary session workspace and is never aliased to Dev World
Outliner and Properties are separate models over stable object IDs
Project/background work reports through Activity / Jobs state rather than panel-owned log buffers
Legacy builder can be removed only after command, document, selection, generation, validation and playtest parity are certified
